question: In a cloud of points we observe that the data are aligned in a decreasing line. Which of the following values ​​of the Pearson correlation coefficient is most appropriate for a situation of that type:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Data points aligned in a decreasing line -> Suggest a negative correlation. CHAIN: Negative correlation -> Pearson correlation coefficient closer to -1. CHAIN: Pearson correlation coefficient closer to -1 -> Option B: r = -1 -> 90%
